# Night Atlas regression artwork

The original Night Atlas map and folding-guide vector plans in this directory
retain the original contributor's rights. They are excluded from the adapter's
MIT license. No CC0, public-domain, or broad artwork reuse license is granted.
Their inclusion is authorized for this repository's real-software regression
and review workflow. CI rendering does not constitute visual acceptance or
publication as a finished showcase.

All geography, venue names, walking routes, durations, and layout are original
and fictional. The documents are not navigation aids. No private map, brand,
photograph, commercial logo, or other third-party artwork is included.

The plans request DejaVu Sans and DejaVu Sans Mono from the test system.
Font binaries are not bundled. The DejaVu/Bitstream Vera font license governs
the installed fonts; native PDF font reports and Fontconfig resolution are
retained in the CI artifact. See https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/License.html.
